description: Alberto Gatto, Paola Parolari and Pierpaolo Boffi of Politecnico di Milano publish experimental measurements of a short-cavity vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser bonded to commercial drivers for the PASSION project. Ten MATLAB files contain time samples for 10-Gb/s OOK and PAM4 modulation, discrete-multitone results, signal-to-noise ratios and training sequences. An XLSX workbook characterises the lasers with the tested drivers. The description identifies measurements over a 10-GHz bandwidth and refers to a project deliverable for the physical connection. These data describe optical-transmitter component performance relevant to communication-system modelling and calibration. Zenodo provides the eleven files freely under CC BY 4.0. The related PASSION WDM-planning record operates at network level and does not establish that it consumed these files. A limitation is that temporal coverage, sample spacing and complete units are absent from the metadata. Laboratory measurements do not establish deployed-network performance.
